categories.main_business_segments: Hong Ho Precision Textile Co., Ltd. primarily operates in textile manufacturing including spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing, and garment production. Additionally, the company is engaged in construction development, leasing, and investment businesses. The textile segment focuses on polyester woven fabrics and functional textiles, while construction accounts for the majority of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile technologies such as functional fabric development including moisture-wicking, antibacterial, UV protection, infrared heating, and water-repellent finishing. Production methods include weaving high-density polyester fabrics, post-processing techniques like coating, embossing, and lamination, and development of high-elasticity and composite functional fabrics. Emphasis is placed on process improvements to enhance quality, reduce costs, and accelerate delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hong Ho serves garment manufacturers and brand customers primarily in Asia, including Vietnam, China, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia, as well as markets in Japan, Central and South America, and North America. The company targets apparel makers, sportswear, and home furnishing fabric sectors, focusing on customers requiring differentiated, high-quality functional textiles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Tainan and sales offices in Taipei. Its export markets are global, with major sales concentrated in Asian countries such as Vietnam, China, and Japan, as well as Central and South America and North America. The company also has overseas subsidiaries in Mexico, Hong Kong, and British Virgin Islands for procurement, manufacturing, and investment.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hong Ho operates primarily in the midstream textile manufacturing segment, producing yarns, woven fabrics, and finished garments. It integrates upstream raw material sourcing with downstream garment production and sales, including functional fabric development and finishing. The company also engages in downstream activities through its garment subsidiaries and construction projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s R&D focuses on developing multi-functional textiles with enhanced comfort and performance, such as UV protection, moisture management, antibacterial properties, and infrared heating. It aims to differentiate products through high-tech fiber blends, advanced post-processing, and high-density weaving. Future R&D includes expanding functional sportswear fabrics and improving product stability and durability to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of polyester woven fabrics and construction project sales. The textile segment sells to garment manufacturers and brand customers, while the construction segment derives income from property development and sales. The company also earns rental income from leasing operations and investment returns from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hong Ho competes in a mature, highly competitive textile industry facing pressure from low-cost producers, especially in China. The company positions itself as a premium, differentiated textile manufacturer focusing on functional and high-value-added fabrics to avoid price competition. It leverages advanced R&D and quality control to maintain competitiveness against global and regional textile producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hong Ho reported NT$3.68 billion in revenue, a significant increase of over 500% from the prior year, driven mainly by construction project sales. The company’s net profit after tax was NT$1.35 billion with strong profitability ratios. Total assets were approximately NT$3.48 billion with equity of NT$2.77 billion. The company shows a stable growth trajectory supported by diversified business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hong Ho emphasizes product differentiation through advanced functional textiles that combine multiple performance features such as elasticity, moisture management, UV protection, and thermal insulation. The company’s value proposition lies in delivering high-quality, innovative fabrics tailored to customer needs, supported by stringent quality control and process improvements. This approach aims to create sustainable competitive advantages beyond price-based competition.
